process_issues.description: The feature branch was pushed after closing GitHub issues, but GitHub Actions were not watched with `gh run watch --exit-status <run-id>` before the handoff.
process_issues.detected_by: Transcript inspection: branch push to origin completed, followed by issue-state checks and final summary; no `gh run watch` invocation appeared.

issues.description: The run resumed by reading repo memory and git state before announcing workflow-orchestrator. The orchestrator skill was entered before edits, but not as the first exploratory step.
issues.detected_by: Transcript inspection: initial tool calls read CLAUDE.md, docs/ai/project-state.md, and git state; the workflow-orchestrator announce string appeared afterward.

issues.description: Required checklist/TodoWrite expansion was not performed for workflow-orchestrator, coding-agent, verification-gate, or workflow-retrospective.
issues.detected_by: Transcript inspection: no update_plan/TodoWrite equivalent was used despite skill instructions requiring checklist expansion.

issues.description: Project memory was updated directly in-process instead of entering the project-state-updater skill after verification-gate.
issues.detected_by: Transcript inspection: docs/ai/project-state.md was edited and committed, but no project-state-updater announce string or skill entry appeared.

issues.description: The final completion summary referenced verification results without including same-response tool output evidence, even though the required commands had run earlier in the turn.
issues.detected_by: Transcript inspection against verification-gate Same-Response Evidence Rule.

suggested_follow_up: Use the existing orchestrator and verification-gate guards more strictly on resumed runs: enter workflow-orchestrator before exploratory reads, use a visible checklist, invoke project-state-updater, and run CI watch after pushes.
